evidence.description: ### 2. Andheri West Metro Station: Line 2A Terminus Andheri West station is the southern end of the Yellow Line, Line 2A, which runs all the way up to Dahisar East, covering close to 18.6 km and 17 stations. This particular stretch, connecting Dahanukarwadi to Andheri West, only opened in January 2023, so it’s a relatively recent addition, and it changed things quite a bit for residents in Lokhandwala, Four Bungalows, and the Yari Road stretch, who previously had no metro option on this side of Andheri at all. [...] The real advantage here is the skywalk. Andheri metro station connects directly to Andheri railway station on the Western Line through a covered footbridge, so switching between metro and local train doesn’t mean stepping onto the road at all. This station serves as the interchange that makes it possible for anyone commuting from further out on the Western Line to get across town. Andheri metro station also connects onward to Chakala, Airport Road, and Marol Naka on the same line, all of which sit inside Andheri East’s commercial belt. ### 2. Andheri West Metro Station: Line 2A Terminus [...] If your destination is Lokhandwala or Four Bungalows, Andheri West is often the nearest metro station to Andheri’s western neighborhoods. It gives Western Andheri direct rail-based access up through Oshiwara, Goregaon West, Malad West, and further north without needing to cross over to the Western Railway line first. ### 3. D.N. Nagar: The Blue-Yellow Interchange D.N. Nagar sits one stop from Versova on the Blue Line and doubles as an interchange point with the Yellow Line. If you’re coming from Versova or Andheri and need to head north towards Goregaon or Malad, D.N. Nagar is usually the switch point rather than going all the way to Andheri West first. ### 4. evidence.description: Physical infrastructure The locality has widespread connectivity through Link Road, SV Road, Western Express Highway, Andheri Railway Station and BEST Bus Network. It also has east-west metro connectivity through the operational Line 1 connecting Versova, Andheri and Ghatkopar. Additionally, the under-construction Line 2 (Dahisar - Mandale), would further boost metro connectivity to the areas to its north and east. Social & retail infra [...] Lively and Livable Living in Andheri West feels balanced. Lokhandwala markets, Versova cafés, good schools, and Kokilaben Hospital are nearby. Metro and rail connectivity save daily commute time despite peak-hour traffic. Image 18 Roshan Agent (Local Guide) 18/07/2024 Andheri West. Andheri West is a very good locality. It is close proximity to malls and Lokandhwala area. It is well connected by trains, buses and public transports. Transport facility is also good in this locality. It has good connectivity to schools, colleges, banks, ATMs and hospitals. S Sanjiv Sharma Agent (Local Guide) 05/03/2024 Every essential things are... Every essential thing is 5 minutes distance like malls, Schools, and Hospitals, and with good connectivity of the metro, Railway, Linkroad, etc. [...] ) ) About Andheri West Locality introduction and neighbourhood Andheri West is a big and developed residential and commercial suburb. The locality encompasses several prominent areas of Lokhandwala Complex, Versova, Seven Bungalows and Four Bungalows. Presence of excellent connectivity, quality social infrastructure, and presence of various commercial entities makes Andheri West a sought-after real estate destination. Andheri West comprises of a number of multi-storey apartment projects along with several co-operative housing societies. Some of the key residential projects by reputed developers in the locality include Oberoi Springs, HDIL Metropolis, Adani Western Heights, Raheja Crest and Runwal Elegante. Physical infrastructure
